{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a99dd656.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    def rotate_cw(a):
        return [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]

    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    b = rotate_cw(a)
    c = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(rotate_cw(a)))
    d = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(a))
    top = [x + y for x, y in zip(a, b)]
    bottom = [x + y for x, y in zip(c, d)]
    return top + bottom
"
